title: The Tianji Sword Emerges
next_chapter_hook: The figure of the Demonic Path commander dissolved gradually in the Void, leaving only a string of terrifying laughter echoing between heaven and earth—the profound meaning within that laughter caused Chen Ji's gaze to freeze, for the next true battle of fate had quietly begun.

text.content: Elder Ling Yuan's voice echoed through the chaotic Void, carrying irresistible pressure—and as the two wills stood at a stalemate, the transcendent gaze of the Heavenly Eye grew increasingly intense, as if the next moment would bring irreversible heavenly punishment. Chen Ji stood in the Void, his garments rustling, yet those deep as abyss eyes were terrifyingly calm. "Fate?" He quietly repeated these two words, the corner of his mouth curving into a derisive arc.

dialogue.content: (Ling Yuan stood with hands clasped behind his back, the Dao's rhyme flowing around him like a river, his tone carrying the ease of one who controls the world) "Indeed, the Tianji Record in your hands is merely a fragment. The true complete path lies within my century-long scheme. Chen Ji, do you think you can defy heaven and change your fate alone? How laughable."

text.content: Upon hearing this, that usually calm face of Chen Ji finally showed a flicker of emotion—not fear, but uncontrollable mockery. He slowly stepped forward, and with each step, visible ripples spread through the Void, a resonance of the Tianji Record's origin within him. "A century-long scheme?" His voice was not loud, yet it clearly pierced through the chaos's roar. "Elder Ling Yuan, wasn't the foundation of your century-long scheme cut off by one chosen by the Tianji Record with a single sword?"

dialogue.content: (The Heavenly Eye's will surged like a tide, carrying the cold indifference of judging all things) "Chen Ji, your choice will determine the future of the Three Realms. Accept the arrangement of fate, or—be reduced to ashes."

choice.prompt: Facing the Heavenly Eye's pressure and Ling Yuan's recruitment, Chen Ji must make a choice—his response will determine the trajectory of this destiny-level confrontation.

choices.description: Use the Tianji Sword to directly sever the threads of fate, proving with strength that his path needs no protection from any existence.
choices.visible_cost: Consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: The complete form of the Tianji Sword manifests, resonating across the Three Realms
choices.risk_hint: May trigger stronger backlash from the Heavenly Eye

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly raised his head, the light erupting from those eyes more blazing than the Heavenly Eye's gaze. He slowly raised his hand, and in the Void, a crystal-clear ancient sword suddenly appeared—that was the materialization of the Tianji Record's origin, the Tianji Sword! The runes flowing on the blade collided violently with the chaotic forces, and the entire Void trembled.

choices.description: Pretend to accept the proposal to enter the tiger's den, while secretly laying out plans to find weaknesses, waiting for a chance to deliver a fatal strike.
choices.visible_cost: Need to endure Ling Yuan's surveillance
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence about Ling Yuan's century-long scheme
choices.risk_hint: If exposed, will fall into a desperate situation

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze flickered slightly, a trace of "struggle" appearing on his face. Upon seeing this, Ling Yuan's eyes flashed with triumph, thinking the boy had finally submitted. However, just as he reached out to take the Tianji Record fragment Chen Ji was offering, the corner of Chen Ji's lowered lips curved into an icy arc—this old fox had finally taken the bait.

choices.description: Demonstrate part of the Tianji Record's power to cause the enemy's apprehension, forcing the Demonic Path commander to retreat temporarily, preserving strength for the subsequent decisive battle.
choices.visible_cost: Expose part of the trump cards
choices.visible_reward: The Demonic Path commander develops apprehension, not daring to act rashly for a century.
choices.risk_hint: May attract the covetous attention of more forces.

text.content: Chen Ji did not draw his sword, only lightly pressing his right hand against the Tianji Record mark on his chest. In an instant, a vast aura like the sea poured out from within him—its purity and antiquity caused Ling Yuan's pupils to contract sharply. He retreated a step, his voice trembling: "This... this is the complete Heavenly Secrets power?! How can you possibly..."

The Tianji Sword erupted with blinding radiance, tearing through the chaotic Void. Those surging dark forces crumbled like paper before this ancient blade. Chen Ji stood sword in hand, the Tianji runes on the blade perfectly resonating with his bloodline, as if this sword had been born for him alone. He stepped slowly toward Ling Yuan, each stride carrying irresistible might. "Elder Ling Yuan, you called me trash?" His voice was terrifyingly calm. "Then let the world witness today—how trash severs your so-called fate."

dialogue.content: (Ling Yuan's expression changed dramatically, Dao Rhythms surging around him wildly, yet unable to conceal the deep fear in his eyes) "Impossible! The Tianji Sword requires the complete Tianji Record to wield—your mere fragment—"

text.content: Chen Ji gave him no chance to finish. The Tianji Sword rose high, and for that instant, the entire Three Realms perceived this power transcending the Heavenly Realm—countless reclusive monsters opened their eyes abruptly, the protective formation arrays of the three great sects simultaneously lit with warning light, and even in the depths of the Tianqing Sect's Forbidden Grounds, an ancient will dormant for ten thousand years trembled slightly. Chen Ji struck down with the sword, calmly uttering four words: "Tianji—Sword Emerges."

Sword energy poured like the Milky Way cascading, and in the instant it swept past, the threads of fate condensed through Ling Yuan's century-long scheme were completely severed. Those causal threads wrapped around Chen Ji shattered one after another, dissolving into scattered starlight that vanished into the Void. Ling Yuan let out a miserable scream, blood spurting from his mouth, his face filled with disbelief—century of painstaking effort, destroyed by a single strike from 'trash'!

dialogue.content: (An unusual flicker of emotion appeared in the Heavenly Eye's will, as if both surprised and satisfied by this outcome) "Interesting... Over ten thousand years, the first human to dare draw a sword beneath Heavenly Punishment. Chen Ji, you are more reckless than any prophet in history."

choice.prompt: After severing the threads of fate with a single strike, Chen Ji faced the Heavenly Eye's gaze and the injured Ling Yuan, needing to decide his next move.

choices.description: Deliver a fatal blow while Ling Yuan is gravely wounded, completely eliminating this lurking threat
choices.visible_cost: Consume significant Heavenly Fate Value; may provoke intervention from the Heavenly Eye
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan's century of cultivation completely ruined, the hidden dangers of Tianqing Sect thoroughly resolved
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may possess a lifesaving trump card

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze turned ice-cold, the Tianji Sword rose once more. However, just as the blade was about to touch Ling Yuan, an overwhelming might like the vast ocean descended from the Void—the Heavenly Eye had intervened!

choices.description: Display the overwhelming power of the complete Tianji Sword form, forcing Ling Yuan and the Demonic Path forces to retreat temporarily
choices.visible_cost: Expose the true might of the Tianji Sword
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan fled in狼狈, the Three Realms shaken, the protagonist's prestige greatly increased
choices.risk_hint: May attract more powerful beings' covetous attention

text.content: Chen Ji did not pursue. Instead, he held the Tianji Sword crosswise before his chest, the blade pointing remotely at Ling Yuan. "Scram." He spoke only this single word, his tone plain as if driving away an ant. Ling Yuan's pupils flashed with intertwined humiliation and fear, finally transforming into a reluctant roar of indignation. His figure vanished into the Void rift.

choices.description: Directly challenge the Heavenly Eye, demanding to know its true purpose and the complete truth of the Tianji Record
choices.visible_cost: May provoke the Heavenly Eye's wrath
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial information, laying groundwork for the final decisive battle
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may give an ambiguous response

text.content: Chen Ji sheathed his sword and stood tall, raising his head to stare directly at that transcendent eye in the Void. "Heavenly Eye, you have used the prophets of all ages as chess pieces, and the Tianji Record is merely one of the pieces you've placed." His voice echoed through the Void. "Then I would like to know—what is your ultimate chess game?"

The instant Ling Yuan fled in狼狈, a venomous voice echoed from within the Void rift: "Chen Ji! Remember this! Today's humiliation, I shall repay a hundredfold!" Yet before his words faded, a sword energy pierced through the Void, shattering that rift completely. Ling Yuan's miserable scream echoed in the chaos, yet it couldn't hide that bone-deep fear.

At this moment, the Three Realms resonated violently. Within the Tianqing Sect, Su Qingyao, who had been in seclusion, suddenly opened her eyes—she sensed that familiar yet strange aura. It was Chen Ji, yet utterly different from the cowardly servant disciple of the past. Her heart pounded violently, anxiety and anticipation intertwining. In the depths of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, Ye Qing's lips curved into a meaningful smile: "So he finally stopped hiding?"

dialogue.content: (The will of the Heavenly Eye receded like a tide, yet in its final moment came a voice laden with profound meaning) "Chen Ji, you surpass all prophets that came before. But remember—the more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger fate's deadly backlash. I await you at the end of the Heavenly Dao."

text.content: Ling Yuan's figure dissolved completely in the void. However, just as everyone believed this destiny-level confrontation had ended, a wild laughter suddenly echoed from the depths of chaos. That laughter shook the entire void, the power within丝毫不弱于方才的天机剑！"陈机！"那笑声戛然而止，取而代之的是一道充满狂热与excited的声音，"不愧是能让天道之眼亲自关注的男人！这一剑，本帅took note of this！"

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji gripped the Tianji Sword, a cold gleam flickering in his eyes, but he did not pursue. He knew the true battle of destiny had yet to begin, and revealing too many trump cards now would only make the subsequent chess game more passive)

text.content: The Demonic Path Commander's voice continued reverberating through the void, carrying amusement and anticipation: "Today was merely this General's probing attack. Your Tianji Sword is indeed powerful, but with your current cultivation, how many strikes can you muster?" Laughter rose again, "The next time we meet will be the true battle of destiny. By then, this General shall make you understand—your so-called choices are merely struggles on the chessboard I have drawn for you!"

As the words fell, that arrogant aura dissipated as well. The void gradually returned to calm, the chaotic forces retreated, and the gaze of the Heavenly Eye slowly faded. Yet Chen Ji knew this was merely the calm before the storm. He lowered his gaze to the Tianji Sword in his hand—the runes on the blade were dimming, as if that single strike had consumed most of its power.

Chen Ji slowly sheathed his sword, a faint weariness appearing on his handsome features. "Probing attack?" he quietly repeated the Demonic Path Commander's words, a mocking curve forming at the corner of his mouth, "Then let me show you what other surprises this 'waste' can give you." He raised his eyes toward the depths of the void, his eyes flashing brilliantly, "The next time we meet, I will make you understand—Chen Ji's path has always been one I walk myself."

As the Demonic Path Commander's figure completely vanished, this earth-shaking destiny-level confrontation finally concluded. Throughout the Three Realms, countless cultivators were horrified by that surge of power—they didn't know what had happened, but they knew that an unparalleled powerhouse had emerged in this battle, cleaving through the threads of destiny with a single sword strike, forcing even the Demonic Path Commander to temporarily retreat!

choice.prompt: The battle concluded. Chen Ji needed to decide his next move—whether to rest and recover his depleted strength, or press on while the momentum was hot?

choices.description: Return to the Tianqing Sect to recover strength, discuss follow-up plans with Su Qingyao, and consolidate the rear
choices.visible_cost: May miss the opportunity to pursue the Demonic Path Commander
choices.visible_reward: Deepen the relationship with Su Qingyao, gaining her trust and support
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may counterattack during this window

dialogue.content: (Su Qingyao's figure manifested in the void, her eyes shimmering with complex emotions—shock, worry, and a trace of barely concealed pride) "Chen Ji... you hid this from me well."

choices.description: Track the Demonic Path Commander's aura, capitalize on the victory, deny the enemy any respite
choices.visible_cost: Strength not fully restored; considerable risk
choices.visible_reward: May completely crush the Demonic Path Commander's forces within the Tianqing Sect, weakening his century-long scheme

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes turned cold. His figure transformed into flowing light as he rushed toward where the Demonic Path Commander had vanished. However, just as he was about to catch up, countless prohibition lights suddenly blazed in the void—it was a trap laid long in advance! The Demonic Path Commander's wild laughter rang out once more: "Chen Ji, did you really think this General would leave no contingency measures? Hahaha!"

Yet, defying all expectations, Chen Ji faced that formation array capable of killing a great master, his expression showing not a trace of fear. He slowly raised his right hand, the Tianji Sword condensing once more in his palm. "Petty tricks." He spoke calmly. Sword light flashed, and that seemingly impenetrable prohibition array shattered like paper. The Demonic Path Commander's laughter stopped abruptly. After a moment of silence, he spat through gritted teeth: "Good! Very good! This General shall see just how many more strikes your Tianji Sword can muster!"

The laughter faded into the distance as the Demonic Path Commander's aura completely vanished from the Three Realms. Chen Ji stood in the void, his robes billowing, resembling a war god descended to earth. Yet only he knew that the previous strike had consumed nearly thirty percent of his Heavenly Fate Value. If battles like this continued, the price of the Tianji Record would become unbearable. He sheathed his sword and stood with profound gaze: "Next time... I will leave you no chance to flee." As his words fell, he turned and flew toward the Tianqing Sect, leaving the Three Realms with an eternal legend.
